narr: A surface trough was oriented south to north across northeast Ohio during the afternoon and early evening of August 8th, 2024, with then Tropical Depression Debby centered over the Carolinas. Strong tropical moisture advection northwestward into the area and modest mixed layer CAPE (1000 j/kg) allowed for thunderstorm development throughout the mid afternoon into the early evening hours, with thunderstorm coverage and intensity increasing near sunset. Deep layer sheer was minimal with slow moving/stationary thunderstorms and intense rainfall rates producing extreme rainfall amounts and flash flooding from eastern Wayne County northeast through Summit County into extreme southeast Cuyahoga and southwest Geauga counties. A narrow axis of 3 to 5 inches of rainfall was estimated by radar across these areas, with rain gauge reports of 5 to 6.6 inches of rainfall within the axis of heaviest rainfall. A majority of the rain fell in about a three hour period, with precipitation frequency estimates equating this amount of rain in a three year period at an average recurrence interval of 1000 years, or about a 0.1% chance of occurrence in any given year.
ev: Widespread flash flooding in Orrville. Several basements flooded, multiple basement wall collapses, including a home on Hostetler Road. Multiple water rescues from vehicles driving into flooded roadways, including Crown Hill Road and Mineral Springs Street, where the water department experienced flooding.

Significant flash flooding in the Merriman Valley area north of Akron and west of Cuyahoga Falls. Canyon Brook Drive near Timber Top Apartments washed out due to flash flooding of Sand Run, with multiple lower level apartment units flooded. Extensive flooding of businesses along Merriman Road and North Portage Path near the Cuyahoga River, with dozens of flooded vehicles. Flooding of basements also reported in this area. The Cuyahoga River at Old Portage crested at 11.53 feet during the onset of the flash flooding impacts in the Merriman Valley.
Several flooded roadways that were closed and impassable due to flooding, including Portage Trail Extension and Valley Road, and State Road near Bath Road.
Hudson Park Drive between Blue Heron Drive and Leeway Drive closed due to flooding.
Road flooding in Bainbridge, including Bainbridge Road and Chillicothe Road at US-422. Yard and minor road flooding near McFarland Creek on Chagrin Road near Westhill Drive.

Widespread flash flooding in Barberton. Several basements were flooded with multiple cars stranded on flooded roadways. Wooster Road at 9th Street NW closed due to flooding. One basement wall collapse reported on 17th Street NW. Two families required water rescue from flooded homes on 15th Street NW.
US-30 flooded, likely due to Sugar Creek overflowing its banks, near Kidron Road. Road was closed and impassable for a period of time.
Road closures due to flooding, including Nautilus Trail and Pirates Trail, in Reminderville. A few reports of basement flooding as well.
I-76 closed due to flooding near Summit Street.
Flash flooding in West Akron. Multiple streets flooded with car stranded, including Mull Avenue near South Hawkins Avenue and near Schneider Park. Reports of basement flooding as well.

Multiple flooded roadways impassable and closed in Cuyahoga Falls, with several cars stalled in the flooded roadways. This includes Graham Road east of State Road, Silver Lake Avenue at Norma Street, and Portage Trail east of State Road. Several basements flooded as well.
Car stranded in flooded roadway on Pine Street in Orrville, requiring water rescue.
Around 20 basements flooded, some street flooding with road closures, including OH-82 between Cannon Road and Depot Road in Twinsburg.
Liberty Road and Cannon Road in Twinsburg closed due to flooding.
Standing water flooding all three eastbound lanes of I-80 near Hudson.
Road flooding with several feet of water inundating the road in Reminderville on Aurora Lake Road at Trentstone Circle.

Reports of flooded and impassable roadways in northeast Hudson, including Pine Trails, Alexandra Drive, Huntington Road, Mayapple Drive, Herrick Park Drive, and Deerpath Trails. Ponds overflowing on Stow Road. Vehicles stuck in water in front of Hudson High School and on Woodspring Lane and Stow Road. 34 homes reported flooding, mainly basement flooding. One partial basement collapse was reported, with 11 rescues from cars stuck in water.
Report of nearly first floor flooding in home on Edgeview Drive in Hudson.
House flooding on Jefferson Street in Orrville, two residents were trapped requiring rescue.

Christmas Run flooded out of its banks at Wayne County Fairgrounds in Wooster, flooding portions of West Old Lincoln Way and much of the fairgrounds. Several barns were flooded with one water rescue of a person trapped in a camper.
Reports of multiple basements flooded and street flooding with stranded vehicles in Orrville.
